cards.title: Partner's Behavior at Kids' Sports Events Straining Relationship
cards.body: A parent seeks advice after 25 years together when their partner's inappropriate conduct at their sons' football matches is becoming a dealbreaker. The advice suggests having a calm conversation to understand the root of the anger rather than focusing on the behavior itself.

cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than Tech Fears
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection, not AI or screens, poses the biggest threat to children's wellbeing. The solution lies in spending more time talking openly with kids rather than obsessing over technology.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic for Your Kids This Year
cards.body: A parent ditches cynicism to celebrate Halloween with children as a moment of genuine magic and connection. The tradition links to centuries-old autumn celebrations like Samhain and Day of the Dead.

cards.title: Benefits of Older Siblings During Adolescence
cards.body: Older siblings influence younger siblings in ways parents often cannot, serving as trusted role models and mentors. This relationship can be especially valuable during the adolescent years.

cards.title: Same-Day Test Detects Hidden Infections in Critically Ill Children
cards.body: Metagenomics offers doctors a new way to quickly detect infections in children in intensive care. This breakthrough can significantly improve treatment outcomes for critically ill young patients.

cards.title: How to Help Kids Handle Party Disappointment
cards.body: When children aren't invited to a peer's party, it can cause real sadness and disappointment. There are practical strategies parents can use to help kids work through these difficult emotions.
